How can a small language model think longer without getting bigger?

Looped transformers run one shared block of layers several times per token. NVIDIA's 4B Dory stores 36 layers and executes 96 when its 20-layer core runs 4 times. The weights never change; only the hidden state does.

It adds computation, not information, and every pass costs latency.

Guide with 7 interactive labs:
https://piszczek.pl/blog/looped-transformers-explained
